novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes that “the same features and heads perform a reasoning step regardless of the input/output language” while “language identity is factored into a separable subspace,” so its novelty route is a circuit-level causal characterization of an alleged language-agnostic reasoning core. Searches for “cross-lingual shared reasoning neurons multilingual LLM,” “language reasoning disentanglement causal intervention,” and “cross-lingual activation patching reasoning” identify very close prior work: Large Language Models Are Cross-Lingual Knowledge-Free Reasoners (NAACL 2024) already hypothesizes shared reasoning neurons from hidden-state similarity and neuron overlap, When Less Language is More (NeurIPS 2025) causally disentangles language-specific representations from multilingual reasoning, and Can You Map It to English? (EACL 2025) uses cross-lingual middle-layer activation patching to establish causal representation alignment. Testing whether identical heads and SAE features implement matched reasoning operations is a modestly finer-grained natural extension of these results, not a new core relationship; the shared reasoning/separable language prediction and much of the causal-intervention framing already exist.
